events.title: SOULRITE Chapter 1 Now Has a Separate Store Page!
events.summary: The SOULRITE demo (also known as Chapter 1) now has its own store page! This allows you to leave a review upon the demo: we'd love to know your thoughts and feedback (and any love and praise for the game is dearly, deeply appreciated)! Simply search for SOULRITE and select 'Soulrite Demo' to view the separate page on Steam.

events.title: Minor bugfix
events.summary: Fixed a bug concerning reloading the game. Sorry if this happened to you - it was the result of a last minute bugfix that had unintended consequences. If you cannot reload your save, exit Steam and restart to update the game, and it should be fixed.

events.title: SOULRITE Chapter 1 is OUT NOW - for free!
events.summary: It's finally here: Chapter 1 of SOULRITE is now available for free! Download the game's demo to begin playing: it's around 4-5 hours of story content and potentially much more if you choose to explore everything. Thank you for checking out SOULRITE and I sincerely hope you have fun! Please do consider sharing it with anyone and everyone who might enjoy it!

events.title: SOULRITE Chapter 1 Releases For Free Next Week!
events.summary: Hello everyone! The goal was to have Chapter 1 out by the 31st of July, though to ensure some final preparations are made we're now aiming to launch at the latest on the 7th of August. We're extremely excited for the world to finally experience SOULRITE and want to ensure we deliver the best possible experience. It also gives us time to exorcise any lingering dark magic that may or may not possess your device otherwise. Stay tuned!
